Today, we introduced the Securing Facilities for Mental Health Services Act.

This bipartisan legislation will eliminate barriers to the development of mental health care facilities, increasing access to care, and working to end the stigma around mental health treatment.

Last week, we introduced the Securing Facilities for Mental Health Services Act.

This bipartisan legislation will eliminate barriers to development of mental health care facilities, increase access to care, and work to end the stigma around mental health treatment.

For those experiencing a mental health crisis, even small barriers to treatment can be life-threatening.

On Saturday, July 16th Americans experiencing a mental health challenge can call or text 988 to be connected with a mental health professional.
